patterns.note: Anthropic API key: sk-ant- followed by at least 20 key characters
GitHub token: ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_ or github_pat_ followed by at least 20 token characters
Hugging Face access token: hf_ followed by at least 20 letters or digits
AWS access key id: AKIA or ASIA followed by 16 uppercase letters or digits
Slack token: xoxb-, xoxa-, xoxp-, xoxr- or xoxs- followed by at least 15 token characters
PEM private-key header line (PRIVATE KEY, RSA, EC, OPENSSH, ENCRYPTED and other labels)
Stripe live secret or restricted key: sk_live_ or rk_live_ followed by at least 20 letters or digits
OpenAI project API key: sk-proj- followed by at least 20 key characters
OpenAI service-account key: sk-svcacct- followed by at least 20 key characters
OpenAI admin key: sk-admin- followed by at least 20 key characters
